name: Carlit Co., Ltd.
summary: Carlit Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial explosives. It offers chemical products, which includes Industrial explosives, signal flares, material assessment services, industrial chemicals, agrichemicals, explosive raw materials, electronic and functional materials, abrasive and polishing materials, and silicon wafers. The company also engages in contract manufacturing of PET bottle beverages and can beverages, as well as produces and supplies tea products.
